identity.name: Admiral's Cove
identity.notes: Gated waterfront community in Jupiter, FL along the Intracoastal Waterway, with a mix of mid-size single-family homes and larger luxury waterfront estates. Popular with boaters; features private docks and community beach access.

fees.note: Exact dues not verified. Typical range for this community is roughly $300-$1,000/month: interior lots on the lower end, waterfront lots with dock usage on the higher end. Boating/dock-related costs (insurance, dock maintenance) are additional for residents with slips. No confirmed CDD special assessments; verify with HOA and title company at closing. Estimates only - confirm with the association's budget and reserve study before purchase.

No CDD assessment figures confirmed from available knowledge; some Jupiter developments carry community development district assessments. Verify with the title company whether any CDD applies to specific lots/phases before closing.

Mandatory MPOA (Master Property Owners Association); average ~$1,058/mo per official site. MPOA contact 561-746-7769, One Admirals Cove Blvd, Jupiter FL 33477 (acmpoa.com). Club dues are separate and mandatory.
Resident-verified range $867-$2,300/mo; observed $980/mo. 893 units. Short-term rentals reported prohibited.

Fees vary by property type/location/sub-association (MPOA plus condo subs); ranges reported ~$1,000-$2,300/mo, often billed quarterly. Transfer fees/capital contributions/special assessments not in public sources.
MLS (Flexmls, pulled 9/30/2026): single-family HOA ~$950-$1,475/mo; condos mostly ~$2,500-$3,300/mo. HOA separate from club dues; membership mandatory.
SF/CD comparison shows $1,471 (single-family) and $2,752 (condo) (likely average HOA by type; labels partially garbled on page). Approximate.
Mandatory club equity membership initiation - Full Golf tier (100% non-refundable).
Annual club dues - Full Golf tier. Per MLS/Echo data golf tier also has $1,300 trail fee; year-1 incl. HOA ~$61,500-$68,000.
Conflicting figure: Sports-tier dues listed as $41,776 (Echo Fine Properties July 2026 comparison) vs $41,766 on official site.

amenities.detail: Community entrance gate controlling access; standard gate/security managed by the HOA.
Homes front directly on the ICW, ideal for boaters with direct waterway access.
Waterfront lots include private docks; dock and slip maintenance is typically part of HOA services.
Community beach access for residents along the ICW shoreline.
Waterfront walking/jogging paths along the canal (approximate; verify current status with HOA).

Deepwater private marina; vessels to 165 ft; single/three-phase and 480V shore power; floating fuel dock (high-speed diesel/gasoline) at member pricing; 2 mi to Jupiter Inlet, 8 mi to Port of Palm Beach.
63-74 deep-water concrete floating slips in staffed basin; dockmaster on staff; mega-yachts 130-165 ft; 500+ private residential docks community-wide (per carlacsoldit.com).
Conflicting figure: 77 deep-water slips accommodating vessels to 110 ft.
Conflicting figure: 93-slip deepwater marina.
45 championship holes: 18-hole East Course plus three 9-hole courses in Golf Village; Golf Performance Center with TrackMan, simulators, Toptracer range.
Official site describes 27-hole championship golf (the Golf Village course); other sources cite 45 total holes. Some sources attribute 'Jack Nicklaus Signature' design (admiralscoveestates.com).
12 tennis courts (per Echo Fine Properties community comparison); no outside members.
Har-Tru tennis and pickleball courts; two fitness centers.
Resort-style pool, locker rooms, card rooms at waterfront East Clubhouse.
Swimming pool with family-only hours and a wading pool for small children.
Bluewater Wellness: spa (incl. salt suite), salon, fitness center with top equipment and certified trainers, rehabilitation services.
Dual clubhouses: East Clubhouse (waterfront, marina views, BlueWater Spa) and Golf Village Clubhouse (porch/lounge overlooking course).
Seven on-site dining venues incl. fine-dining seafood restaurant Blü and Marina Cafe with brick pizza oven.
Waterside Private Boutique Hotel: 32 rooms on 3rd/4th floors of clubhouse with waterfront balconies; member sponsorship required for bookings.
Covesters children's program: drop-in care, camps, crafts, sports, games, swimming; school-holiday programming.
24/7 armed dual guard gates (Alt A1A/US-1), checkpoints, thermal monitoring, land and marine patrols; guard-gated.
Marine Security unit patrols canals/harbor; boat transponders issued for waterway access.
5.5-mile deep-water canal system, zero fixed bridges to Intracoastal/Jupiter Inlet; 6+ ft depth at mean low water; 15-20 min idle speed to Atlantic.
MPOA maintains ~1,000 acres, 13 miles of roadway, 7 miles of navigable waterways, common grounds and golf courses.
Pets allowed on leash (resident-reported; confirm with association).
Resident organizations incl. Yacht Club, Photography Club, Fishing Club; community parks/green spaces.
45 holes of championship golf within the community and surrounding Jupiter golf/country club area (golf course frontage available on Harbour Homes).
74-slip marina; many homes are waterfront with private docks.
Large clubhouse featuring a spa, fitness center, golf pro shop, and casual and fine dining locations.
12 tennis courts.
Olympic sized pool with poolside bar and café.
Personal Wachovia Bank available for residents.
Over 5 miles of waterways winding throughout the community; many homes are waterfront, and some land parcels are located directly on the Intracoastal Waterway.

demographics.geography_level: ZIP code 33477 (Jupiter, FL) - Census ACS via aggregator; community itself not separately censused as a gated enclave in this ZIP; Golf Village section partly in ZIP 33458 per palmbeachcountyhomeforsale.com. Note: ZIP-level data is not community-level; Admiral's Cove households skew wealthier than ZIP median ($2.3M+ entry prices). Pop 12,908 (2024 ACS; 2020 census 12,683); 94.2% White; median home value $670,800; 22.4% of households (per uspopulation.org) earn $200k+ in adjacent ACS vintages - do not rely on ZIP medians as community medians. Second vintage: uspopulation.org/florida/33477 (ACS 5-yr 2017-2021): pop 11,712, median age 67.7, median HH income $99,865, mean HH income $165,462, per capita $93,479. Owner-occupancy 86.27% (2024, occupied units); 59.6% adults 25+ hold bachelor's or higher. Median age 67.9 (2024). Median household income $104,992 (2024).

demographics_history.geography_level: city (Jupiter) - community-level data not reliably available from my knowledge base; figures are city-wide approximations from Census/ACS-type data, 2022 vintages. Owner-occupancy and income in the community itself are likely above city averages given the waterfront, higher-priced home stock.

Jupiter Public Library (Palm Beach County Public Library System)

Harbourside Place - waterfront mixed-use retail/restaurants/events (~5 min drive); further options along US-1/Donald Ross corridor; Worth Avenue ~30 min; Gardens Mall/PGA Commons 15-20 min south (carlacsoldit.com)
Grocery runs 'a few minutes' via US-1 and Indiantown Road shopping; no specific store identified in sources read

Jupiter Branch, Palm Beach County Library System - 705 Military Trail, Jupiter FL 33458; per pbclibrary.org located just across from Jupiter High School; 22,000 sq ft, seed library, teen section, free WiFi (citylibrary.com)
Jupiter Medical Center - ~10 min drive from Admirals Cove per community guide; described as Palm Beach County's top-rated community hospital
Jupiter Medical Center, 1210 S Old Dixie Hwy, Jupiter FL 33458 (Healthgrades location listing)
Public schools assigned to Admirals Cove address (344 Spyglass Way, Admirals Cove neighborhood): Lighthouse Elementary, Jupiter Middle, Jupiter High (Palm Beach County School District)

School zone listed as Lighthouse/Beacon Cove Elementary, Jupiter Middle School of Technology, Jupiter High School (conflicts slightly with Zillow 'Jupiter Middle'); Lighthouse/Beacon Cove PTO address 4750 Dakota Dr, Jupiter FL 33458 (PTO records)
Wachovia Bank (personal bank available for residents)

open_questions: Community beach access (mentioned in buyer's notes) could not be verified on any page read - no source mentions a community beach; confirm with MPOA/Club.

CDD/special assessments: no published schedule found; hoabulletinboard says capital contributions/assessments not in public sources; palmbeachluxury advises budgeting for capital assessments - request current MPOA budget and any pending assessments (561-746-7769).

Marina slip count conflicts: 63 (housevaluelab/carlacsoldit), 63-74 (official site), ~65 (nationalmarinadatabase.com), 77 (palmbeachluxury.com), 93 (admiralscoveestates.com) - confirm current inventory with Marina Operations.
Public school zone naming differs across sources (Jupiter Middle vs Jupiter Middle School of Technology vs 'Jupiter Elementary'); verify with Palm Beach County School District.
Driving distances in miles to Jupiter Medical Center, Jupiter Branch Library, Lighthouse Elementary and Harbourside Place not found - only drive times (10 min, 5 min).
Pet policy is resident-reported only (hoa-agent.com); confirm current MPOA pet rules.
Golf design attribution: 'Robert von Hagge' (palmbeachcountyhomeforsale.com) vs 'Jack Nicklaus Signature' (admiralscoveestates.com) - unverified.
Demographics are ZIP-code level (33477/33458), not community-specific census data; community households are far wealthier than ZIP medians (entry $2.3M+, 12-month single-family median $7.3M per MLS).
